name: Yi Peng 3 replay separates placed positions from recorded AIS (signed in)
description: Validates the two-day Yi Peng 3 case, whose track is placed from statements until 06:01 UTC on 18 November and recorded AIS after: the list carries a date on the first row of each day, Ship mode says which basis the numbers rest on, and Evidence mode lists the recorded stretch and its archive.

planSteps.description: Type testsprite-console-09+clerk_test@example.com in the "Email address" field and click Continue
Wait until the code screen ("Check your email") shows "Didn't receive a code?", then type 424242; Clerk usually continues by itself after the 6th digit, so click Continue only if it is still shown

If Clerk answers "You need to send a verification code before attempting to verify", click Resend once it is enabled and type 424242 again; then wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Navigate to /cases/yi-peng-3-2024 and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert the case switcher (data-testid case-switcher) reads "Yi Peng 3 anchor drag" and the event list (data-testid event-list) heading reads "17 and 18 November, minute by minute"
Assert the first row of the event list shows the date "17 Nov" under its time and a later row shows "18 Nov"
Click the row "Slows from 7.6 knots to under 1 and holds position for 75 minutes"
Assert the replay clock (data-testid replay-clock) reads "08:24 UTC" and the line right under it reads "18 Nov 2024, 09:24 in Stockholm"
Click "Ship" in the mode switch (data-testid mode-switch)
Assert the card "Derived at this moment" is headed "At 08:24 UTC", is marked "from AIS", and says "Speed as the ship broadcast it"
Click "Replay" in the mode switch, click the row "C-Lion1 stops carrying traffic", then click "Ship" again
Assert the card "Derived at this moment" is headed "At 02:00 UTC", is marked "derived", and says the speed is "never a recorded speed"
Assert the entry with data-testid recorded-track-entry contains "Recorded AIS from 06:01 to 10:59, 114 positions"
Assert the sources sheet (data-testid source-list) lists "AIS data archive, aisdk-2024-11-18.zip" from the Danish Maritime Authority
